chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, from Al-Maythami, from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever performs salat (prayer) outside its time, then there is no salat for him.
ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about performing salat outside its prescribed time?
ai.summary: This hadith states that salat (prayer) is only valid when performed within its prescribed time. It emphasizes the legal and devotional importance of observing the appointed times of worship in Islamic practice.
